form.label: Imperva IOC Block V2 – audit log
form.description: Every Block / Unblock / Detection-rule change from the dashboards, stored in the CSV lookup imperva_audit.csv (| inputlookup imperva_audit). Export: the ⤓ Export button under the table → CSV. Below: Auto unblock run now, the WAF policies it works on and the unblock log.

input.label: 🔎 Search IP / Ticket / user / description (* = all)

search.query: | inputlookup imperva_audit | eval _time=tonumber(time) | where $a_days$=0 OR _time>=relative_time(now(), "-$a_days$d@d") | search action=$a_act|s$ | eval ticket=replace(coalesce(ticket, "-"), "(?i)ITHM\s*-?\s*", "") | eval _q=replace(lower(trim(replace($a_q|s$, "[*]", ""))), "^ithm[\s:#-]*", "") | where _q="" OR like(lower(ip." ".ticket." ".user." ".description." ".action), "%"._q."%") | sort 0 - _time | eval time=strftime(_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table time user action ip ticket description status verified policy backend soar_container detail

panel.title: Auto unblock – run now (same as the daily run at 02:17)

search.query: | makeresults | impervaautounblock action=list | eval _r=$au_refresh|s$ | stats count(eval(status_code="due")) AS due | eval Run=if(due>0, "▶ RUN NOW (".due." due)", "Nothing due now"), note=if(due>50, "50 per run - the rest at the next run", "-") | table Run due note

panel.title: Auto unblock result – written to the audit log (click a row to close)

search.query: | makeresults | impervaautounblock action=run | eval _r=$au_run_now|s$ | `imperva_audit_write` | table time ip action status verified policy ticket description detail

panel.title: Policies with BLOCK IP rules – their IDs must be in IMPERVA_POLICY_IDS of the V2 SOAR playbook

search.query: | makeresults | impervaautounblock action=policies | eval _r=$au_refresh|s$ | table policy_id policy_name own_policy block_ip_rules cloud shared due attacks_24h

panel.title: Unblock / auto unblock log – last 30 days (audit log)

search.query: | inputlookup imperva_audit | eval _t=tonumber(time) | where _t>=relative_time(now(), "-30d@d") AND (action="unblock" OR like(action, "auto_unblock%")) | sort 0 - _t | eval time=strftime(_t, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), ticket=replace(coalesce(ticket, "-"), "(?i)ITHM\s*-?\s*", "") | table time user action ip policy status ticket description detail
